title: Adomate
claim: Product Hunt: Adomate — Turn data into winning ads. At scale.
why_good: Turns data into ad creative at scale — a big, budget-rich market (performance marketing) where AI creative has clear ROI.
value: Subscription + usage to SMB/agency advertisers; ad spend is huge and teams pay for anything that lifts ROAS.
risk: Crowded AI-ads space (AdCreative, Meta's own tools); creative quality + measurable lift are the bar to clear.
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score

zh.claim: Product Hunt: Adomate —— 把数据变成能赢的广告,规模化。
zh.why_good: 把数据规模化变成广告创意——一个大、预算充足的市场(效果营销),AI 创意 ROI 清晰。
zh.value: 向中小企业/代理商广告主收订阅 + 用量;广告预算巨大,凡是能提升 ROAS 的团队都愿付费。
zh.risk: AI 广告很挤(AdCreative、Meta 自家工具);创意质量 + 可衡量的提升是必须过的门槛。
